description: Catch what the PR gate cannot: dependency install and setup time, runner-image changes, cross-PR creep and xdist imbalance. A scheduled workflow reads the last day of trunk.yml develop runs and their jobs (about 45 API calls; not make ci-usage-report, which is rate-limit-heavy and reported INCOMPLETE), computes per-job p50 (fast, each medium shard, correctness gates) and the fast-junit summed-time p50, compares with the prior 7 days, and opens or updates one pinned issue naming the jobs that rose more than 15%, closing it when healthy. PR time-to-green is not used (dominated by review latency).
